core_loop.name: Set the Scene
core_loop.description: GM describes scenario, establishing surroundings, dangers, NPCs, and important details

core_loop.name: Ask and Answer Questions
core_loop.description: Players ask clarifying questions, GM responds with info or asks questions back. Build fiction collaboratively.

core_loop.name: Build on the Fiction
core_loop.description: Players describe actions. Auto-succeed if no failure chance or failure would be boring. Otherwise GM calls for action roll. Work outcome into story.

core_loop.name: Repeat
core_loop.description: GM relays updated details. Continue until scene ends mechanically or organically.

spotlight.description: Symbol representing table's attention and immediate narrative/mechanical focus
spotlight.movement: Moves organically or via mechanical trigger (e.g., failed roll triggers GM move)

turn_order.description: No rigid initiative. No set action count. Player describes action, spotlight swings to:
priorities: Who a triggered mechanic puts it on

optional_tracker.name: Spotlight Tracker Tool
optional_tracker.mechanics: Each player starts with 3 tokens, removes one per action. When out, spotlight goes elsewhere. Refill when all players exhausted.

overview.trigger: Required when move is difficult or risky. Auto-succeed if trivial or failure would be boring.
overview.dice: Duality Dice: 2 visually distinct d12s (Hope die and Fear die)
overview.procedure: Roll, sum results, apply modifiers, compare to Difficulty

success_with_hope.condition: Total >= Difficulty AND Hope Die > Fear Die

success_with_fear.condition: Total >= Difficulty AND Fear Die > Hope Die
success_with_fear.result: Succeed with cost/complication, GM gains a Fear

failure_with_hope.condition: Total < Difficulty AND Hope Die > Fear Die
failure_with_hope.result: Fail with minor consequence, gain a Hope, spotlight swings to GM

failure_with_fear.condition: Total < Difficulty AND Fear Die > Hope Die
failure_with_fear.result: Fail with major consequence, GM gains a Fear, spotlight swings to GM

critical_success.result: Auto-succeed with bonus, gain a Hope, clear a Stress. If attack: deal critical damage

failing_forward.principle: Every roll changes the scene. No 'nothing happens' results. Fiction constantly evolves.

procedure_steps.name: Pick Appropriate Trait
procedure_steps.description: Some actions specify trait. Otherwise GM tells player which trait applies.

procedure_steps.name: Determine Difficulty
procedure_steps.description: Some actions specify Difficulty. Otherwise GM determines based on scenario. GM may or may not share Difficulty but should communicate potential failure consequences.

procedure_steps.name: Apply Extra Dice and Modifiers
procedure_steps.description: Player decides to Utilize Experience or activate effects. Add tokens/dice (advantage, Rally) to pool. Must declare before rolling.

procedure_steps.name: Roll the Dice
procedure_steps.description: Roll entire pool, announce as '[total] with [Hope/Fear]' or 'Critical Success!'

procedure_steps.name: Resolve Outcome
procedure_steps.description: Player and GM work together with table to resolve action outcome

trait_rolls.description: Action roll specifying which character trait applies
trait_rolls.note: Features affecting trait rolls also affect standard action rolls, attack rolls, and Spellcast rolls using that trait

spellcast_rolls.description: Trait rolls using Spellcast trait (determined by subclass)
spellcast_rolls.note_damage: Spellcast Roll that can damage is also an attack roll

spell_duration.ending: Text specifies when effect ends, or GM spends Fear to end temporary effect, or caster chooses, or natural story moment
spell_duration.multiple: Can cast and maintain multiple spells simultaneously

reaction_rolls.description: Made in response to attack/hazard. Attempt to avoid/withstand imminent effect
differences_from_action_rolls: Other characters can't Help an Ally
reaction_rolls.critical_success: Don't clear Stress or gain Hope, but ignore any success effects (damage, marking Stress)

procedure: Party chooses one PC to lead
Others make reaction rolls using appropriate traits
Leader gains +1 per successful reaction roll, -1 per failed reaction roll

tag_team_rolls.limit: Once per session per player (but can participate in multiple)
procedure: Choose one roll to apply to both actions
On roll with Hope: all involved gain Hope
On roll with Fear: GM gains Fear per PC involved
tag_team_rolls.attack_damage: Both roll damage, add totals together, treat as single source. Choose damage type if different.
tag_team_rolls.note: Counts as single action roll for countdown/tracking purposes

advantage.description: Seize opportunity to increase success chance
advantage.mechanics: Roll d6 advantage die, add to total

disadvantage.mechanics: Roll d6 disadvantage die, subtract from total

advantage_and_disadvantage.stacking: Cancel one-for-one. Never roll both simultaneously. External sources (like Help an Ally) stack with rolled results.

uses.name: Help an Ally
uses.effect: Describe how you help, roll advantage die. Multiple can help, only highest result added.

uses.name: Utilize an Experience
uses.effect: Add Experience modifier to roll. Can spend multiple Hope for multiple Experiences.

uses.name: Initiate Tag Team Roll
uses.effect: Combine two PC actions. Both roll, choose which results apply.

uses.name: Activate Hope Feature
uses.note: Hope gained from roll 'with Hope' can be spent on that feature immediately

fear.description: Metacurrency powering GM and adversary abilities
fear.uses: Make/enhance GM moves, use Fear Features

evasion.description: Character's ability to avoid attacks and unwanted effects
evasion.mechanics: Rolls against PC use target's Evasion as Difficulty. Base determined by class, modified by cards/equipment/conditions.
evasion.note: Attacks against adversaries use target's Difficulty instead

hit_points.when_last_marked: Character falls. PC makes death move.

damage_thresholds.major: Mark 2 HP (at or above Major, below Severe)
damage_thresholds.none: No HP marked if damage reduced to 0 or less

hit_points_and_damage.optional_massive_damage: If damage >= 2x Severe threshold, mark 4 HP instead of 3

stress.description: Mental, physical, emotional strain character can endure
stress.when_last_marked: Become Vulnerable until at least 1 cleared
stress.overflow: When must mark but can't, mark 1 HP instead
stress.restriction: Can't use move requiring Stress if all marked

attack_rolls.description: Action roll intended to inflict harm
attack_rolls.trait: Specified by weapon/spell. Unarmed uses Strength or Finesse (GM choice)

damage_rolls.spellcast_damage: Roll dice equal to Spellcast trait. If +0 or lower, roll nothing.
damage_rolls.weapon_damage: Dice count = Proficiency. Proficiency multiplies dice, not modifier. E.g., Proficiency 2 with d8+2 weapon deals 2d8+2.

critical_damage.trigger: Critical success (matching Duality Dice) on attack roll
critical_damage.calculation: Roll damage normally, then add maximum possible dice result to total. E.g., 2d8+1 becomes 2d8+1+16

damage_types.physical: From mundane weapons and unarmed attacks (unless stated otherwise)

resistance_immunity.resistance: Reduce incoming damage of that type by half before comparing to thresholds. Apply resistance before other reductions. Multiple resistances to same type don't stack.
resistance_immunity.immunity: Ignore incoming damage of that type
resistance_immunity.mixed_damage: Only benefit from resistance/immunity if resistant/immune to BOTH types
resistance_immunity.direct_damage: Can't be reduced by marking Armor Slots

attacking.multi_target_attacks: Make one attack roll, one damage roll. Apply results to each target individually.
attacking.multiple_damage_sources: Damage from simultaneous sources totaled before comparing to thresholds

melee.description: Close enough to touch, up to a few feet away

very_close.description: Close enough to see fine details, about 5-10 feet
very_close.movement: Can move from Very Close to Melee as part of action while in danger
very_close.map: Within shortest length of game card (2-3 inches)

close.description: Close enough to see prominent details, about 10-30 feet
close.movement: Can move from Close to Melee as part of action while in danger

far.description: Close enough to see very little detail, about 30-100 feet
far.movement: Must make Agility Roll to safely move from Far to Melee while in danger
far.map: Within length of copy paper long edge (11-12 inches)

very_far.description: Too far to make out details, about 100-300 feet
very_far.movement: Must make Agility Roll to safely move from Very Far to Melee while in danger
very_far.map: Beyond Far range but within conflict/scene bounds

range_mechanics.maximum: Stated range is maximum, can use at closer distances unless noted

movement_under_pressure.with_action_roll: Can move to location within Close range as part of action
movement_under_pressure.without_action_or_farther: Need successful Agility Roll to safely reposition
movement_under_pressure.adversary: Move within Close range free as part of action, or within Very Far as separate action

area_of_effect.default: All targets within Very Close range of single origin point within effect's range

line_of_sight_and_cover.line_of_sight: Ranged attacker must have LoS to target unless stated otherwise

cover.partial_obstruction: Target has cover. Attacks through cover have disadvantage.

hidden.requirements: Out of sight from all enemies AND they don't know location
hidden.effect: Rolls against Hidden creature have disadvantage
hidden.ends: Adversary moves to see you, you move into LoS, or you attack

restrained.effect: Can't move but can take actions from current position

vulnerable.effect: All rolls targeting creature have advantage

temporary.description: Denotes condition creature can clear by making move against it
temporary.clearing_pc: Successful action roll using appropriate trait
temporary.clearing_adversary: GM spotlights adversary, describes how they clear it. No roll needed but uses spotlight.

special.description: Only cleared when specific requirements met
special.requirements: Stated in effect text that applies condition

conditions.stacking: Unless noted, same condition can't be applied more than once to same target

short_rest.limit: If take 3 short rests in row, next must be long rest

moves_list.name: Tend to Wounds
moves_list.effect: Clear 1d4+Tier HP for self or ally

moves_list.name: Repair Armor
moves_list.effect: Clear 1d4+Tier Armor Slots from self or ally's armor

moves_list.name: Prepare
moves_list.effect: Describe preparation, gain Hope. If with 1+ party members, each gains 2 Hope.

end_effects: Can move domain cards between loadout and vault for free

long_rest.interruption: If interrupted, only gain short rest benefits

moves_list.name: Tend to All Wounds
moves_list.effect: Clear all HP for self or ally

moves_list.name: Repair All Armor
moves_list.effect: Clear all Armor Slots from self or ally's armor

moves_list.name: Prepare
moves_list.effect: Describe preparation, gain Hope. If with 1+ party members, each gains 2 Hope.

moves_list.name: Work on a Project
moves_list.effect: With GM approval, pursue long-term project. Assign countdown on first start. Either advance automatically or make action roll (GM choice).

end_effects: Features with per-rest or per-long-rest uses refresh
Effects lasting 'until next rest' or 'until next long rest' expire
Can move domain cards between loadout and vault for free
long_rest.gm_consequence: GM gains 1d4 + number of PCs Fear and can advance long-term countdown

trigger_when_pc: Rolls with Fear on action roll
Looks to GM for what happens next

fear_features.description: Especially powerful/consequential moves GM must spend Fear to activate
fear_features.note: Fear cost is in addition to Fear spent to seize spotlight or activate other actions

when_spotlighted_can: Move within Close range and make standard attack
Move within Close range and use adversary action
Sprint within Far or Very Far range on battlefield
Do anything else fiction demands or GM deems appropriate
adversary_actions.additional_spotlights: GM can spend additional Fear to spotlight more adversaries

player_principles: Be a fan of your character and their journey
Address the characters and address the players
Play to find out what happens
